entries.name: Habit de présentation
entries.prompt: Create ONE finished static 2D/2.5D game sprite, one complete character/entity, single neutral pose looking or oriented screen RIGHT in three-quarter side view. Entire silhouette within frame, at least5percent transparent margins, coherent physical weight and attachments. Truly transparent background. No backdrop, ground plane, cast shadow, haze, UI, text, labels, repeated views, comparison layout or sprite sheet. This is an original CQC costume/design, not a claim of official released-game outfit or recovery of old PNG bytes. VIRGIL AT-9 machine from the provided reference: preserve its exact mechanical identity, proportions and primary construction: a tall cylindrical black central module with slightly domed upper cap, broad circular upper collar with THREE horizontal red illuminated grille bars wrapping around the visible front, vertically stacked circular front optical ports with a small red lower sensor, slim vertical side access-panel strips, and a separate low circular lower support/base RING. These are TWO COMPONENTS of ONE complete machine assembly, not two duplicated robots. Preserve both main cylinder and lower ring/base, the small mechanical separation between them, the width relationship and round geometry. Original ceremonial variant: high-quality black enamel chassis with subtle IVORY METAL segmented front/side panel inlays and slim ivory bands around the lower base, small machined brass fasteners. The ivory pieces are actual bolted machine access panels following the cylinder curvature, NOT human shirt collars or lapels. NO cloth bowtie, no human clothing, no suit arms or legs, no humanoid torso, no face or skin. The red signal grille and optics remain unobstructed. Elegant restrained presentation finish with physically credible metal seams. ONE complete Virgil assembly only, based on the first source image.

entries.name: Carapace segmentée
entries.prompt: Create ONE finished static 2D/2.5D game sprite, one complete character/entity, single neutral pose looking or oriented screen RIGHT in three-quarter side view. Entire silhouette within frame, at least5percent transparent margins, coherent physical weight and attachments. Truly transparent background. No backdrop, ground plane, cast shadow, haze, UI, text, labels, repeated views, comparison layout or sprite sheet. This is an original CQC costume/design, not a claim of official released-game outfit or recovery of old PNG bytes. Design a NEW ORIGINAL CQC all-machine Metal Gear variant inspired ONLY by SolidSnake MGS1 visual color/equipment codes, titled Carapace segmentee. The old term TurtleArmor is NOT a verified canonical outfit and is NOT the title of an official machine. This is genuinely ALL-MECHANICAL: NO human head, no hair, no skin, no fabric, no clothing, no pilot visible, no humanoid face or organic turtle. Use the reference machine only for solid industrial joint construction and navy/grey palette. Create a distinctive broad protective domed reactor HULL covered in overlapping SEGMENTED navy-blue and cool-grey armored CARAPACE plates, like engineered overlapping shield tiles, with a low integrated angular sensor WEDGE at the front containing a thin cyan-blue optic strip. No separate human-like neck/head. TWO powerful reverse-jointed walking legs mounted beneath the shell, visible heavy pivot bearings and hydraulic cylinders anchored at both ends, wide angular three-toed steel feet securely on the same ground plane in perspective. Compact armored shoulder/side utility pods echo SolidSnake belt equipment as hard-shell machine storage, and two short rigid blue sensor fins echo the bandana color without being hair or fabric ribbons. Deliberate squat heavy silhouette and protective rounded shell, distinct from the long narrow previous Rex-like machine. Exactly one machine with two legs, coherent joints, no human limbs or hands. Neutral right-facing static stance, complete domed shell and feet inside frame, detailed hard-surface hand-painted 2.5D sprite.
